name: com.jwatte/site
title: jwatte.com website tools
description: Website tool catalog, browser run links, article search and book catalog details from jwatte.com.

tools.name: list_audit_tools
tools.description: Returns a page from the jwatte.com website-tool catalog in directory order, filtered by category or matching keywords. Each entry has a slug, title, category, description, source link and takes_url flag indicating whether it supports a browser run link. Includes the total count and next offset; 1 to 20 entries per page.

category.description: Optional category: audits, generators or utilities; absent means all categories.

search.description: Keywords that must all appear in the title, slug, tags or description, e.g. "schema".

limit.description: Tools per page (1 to 20, default 10). More results are available using next_offset.

offset.description: Number of entries before this page, matching the previous next_offset value.

tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Matches a website-checking or creation need against the jwatte.com catalog using weighted words, related terms and phrase matches. Returns up to 10 matching tools with titles, descriptions, source links and takes_url flags indicating support for browser run links.

need.description: What the person wants to check or build, in their words.

category.description: Optional: only audits, generators or utilities.

limit.description: How many tools at most (1 to 10, default 5).

examples.need: check my website for accessibility problems

tools.name: get_audit_link
tools.description: Creates a browser run link for a catalog tool that supports website addresses. Opening the link fills in the address and starts that tool, which may fetch the target through the site hosting function and configured proxies. The MCP call itself never fetches or audits the target and returns no audit findings. Accepts public HTTP or HTTPS addresses only; rejects private addresses, internal names, credentials and non-standard ports.

url.description: The public page or site to audit. A bare host name uses HTTPS.

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Searches the jwatte.com article catalog by keyword and returns up to 25 matches ranked by relevance, each with a title, publication date, source link and summary.

limit.description: How many articles at most (1 to 25, default 10).

tools.name: list_recent_articles
tools.description: Lists jwatte.com articles by publication date, newest first, from the same catalog as the blog and its RSS feed. Optional since date (YYYY-MM-DD) and paging with offset and next_offset; 1 to 25 per page. Each article has a title, publication date, source link and summary.

limit.description: How many articles at most (1 to 25, default 10).

offset.description: Number of newer articles to skip, matching the previous next_offset value.

since.description: Optional: only articles published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: get_book_info
tools.description: Catalog details for one of J.A. Watte's six books by slug: title, subtitle, page count, format, listed price, a short factual summary, Amazon link and companion website. Slugs: w2trap, condotrap, resaletrap, 97launch, 20agency, 100network. Prices are catalog values, not a live retailer lookup.

slug.description: w2trap (The W-2 Trap), condotrap (The Condo Trap), resaletrap (The Resale Trap), 97launch (The $97 Launch), 20agency (The $20 Dollar Agency), 100network (The $100 Network).

tools.name: recommend_book
tools.description: Matches a reading topic against subject phrases and related-word rules for J.A. Watte's six-book catalog. A match returns a title, a topic-based reason, and links. Only a clearly matched subject receives a book. An unmatched topic returns no book and no Amazon link. This searches only the publisher's own catalog.

topic.description: The reader's situation, goal or topic, in their words.
